column1: # ports.tsv -- THE source of truth for targets, implied C++ engines, and 6809-visible I/O addresses (spec section 7).
# All tokens are canonical lowercase.  Addresses are 16-bit hex in 0xff00..0xffff; 0xff7f is FORBIDDEN (Multi-Pak).
#   port    on     run        for          device             first   last
#   host    on     engine|*   device       first              last
# === 1. Valid (on, run, for) targets -> implied C++ IN_RAM engine ===
# --- tfr911h (TFR/911H: Hamster PIO, RP2350B owns the entire 64K bus) ---
# --- coco2 (Centipede 32z in a CoCo 1 or CoCo 2: Gerbil PIO, no motherboard GIME/MMU) ---
# --- coco3 (Centipede 32z in a real CoCo 3: Gerbil PIO, motherboard already has GIME/MMU/RAM) ---
# === 2. Host motherboard reserved ranges (cartridge/enhancements must never overlap these) ===
# === 3. Core RP2350-claimed I/O register ranges per (on, run, for) ===
# --- tfr911h: nitros9l2 for jamesbrown (Andrew Diller's L2 I/O addresses; tfr911h only) ---
# --- tfr911h: nitros9l2 for coco3 (CoCo-3-compatible L2 on TFR/911H) ---
# --- tfr911h: hatvan for gep9 / gep9big / coco2 (Hatvan I/O Spec v2.0) ---
# --- tfr911h: fuzix for multicomp09 (port ABI decoded directly by hamster_multicomp) ---
# --- coco2: nitros9l1 / nitros9l2 / hatvan / fuzix / rsbasic ---
# (coco2 rsbasic for coco2 has 0 core $FFxx ports: 64K RAM substitution below $FF00)
# --- coco3: real CoCo 3 owns GIME/MMU/RAM/vectors under gerbil_io ---
# (coco3 rsbasic for coco3 has 0 core $FFxx ports: real CoCo 3 owns GIME/MMU/RAM/ROM)
# === 4. Enhancement map e1 (Enhancement map 1; CoCo-safe default addresses) ===
